BrushLLM Player 0.0.13 improves fullscreen playback controls and macOS file associations.

- On macOS, double-clicking the video switches fullscreen modes without pausing playback. The player reduces redraw work during the transition.
- On macOS and Windows, the fullscreen control bar includes a volume slider next to the mute button.
- On macOS, the player registers the `.iso9660` disc image extension. File association settings list any extensions whose default application could not be changed.
- The build and test workflows use Node.js 24 LTS and Actions that support the Node.js 24 runtime.

| Platform | Installer |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 14 or later, Apple Silicon | `BrushLLM.Player-0.0.13-arm64.dmg` |
| Windows, x64 | `BrushLLM.Player-0.0.13-x64.exe` |
| Windows, ARM64 | `BrushLLM.Player-0.0.13-arm64.exe` |
